text: Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's explanation, current supplied text): 1 if the OP's own prose directly addresses the reader/audience in second person (you, your, yours, yourself, you're, or reader-directed imperatives like "consider..." or "imagine..."); otherwise 0. Generic "you" counts only if it actually addresses the reader (the spec's wording on generic "you" is garbled/ambiguous). "You" inside quoted text attributed to others, quoted opponents, or example dialogue does not count. Text with only impersonal, first-person or third-person phrasing gives 0. Excluded from consideration: OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including such edits); generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Do not infer an initial snapshot or remove other edits. Missing or malformed argument gives null; an empty but valid string gives 0.
